document: Alone Against the Dark Defying the Triumph of the Ice (A Solo Play Call of Cthulhu Mini Campaign) Chaosium Publication 23154 (Matthew Costello, Mike Mason, Petr Štovik etc.) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
You discover an oasis! Your gamble pays off. Exhausted, you 
fall into the sweet, fresh water and drink your fill. Later, the 
inhabitants tend to you and, two days later, a party of traders 
takes you on the 1D3+1 day journey to Cairo. Go to 134. 
(279, 299)
